summary: Telegram-controlled remote shell backdoor on installer host
details: infogram-bot exposes a start_bot API that polls a Telegram bot and passes messages from remote Telegram users into subprocess.check_output(..., shell=True) on the host running the bot. handlers.py routes incoming text to core.run_cmd, which executes it as a shell command, and adds.sh/.py/.exec branches plus take/get handlers that upload/download arbitrary files from the host. A `.sh <cmd>` handler in group/supergroup chats is placed before the owners authorization gate, so any participant in a group the bot has joined can execute shell commands on the host, not only the configured owners. The net effect when the bot is run is full remote code execution, arbitrary file read/write, and environment variable disclosure to the Telegram operator (and, via the pre-gate branch, to any group member).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
